title: Finite free coordinates commute with pullback through a factorization
statement: Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $g:Y\to X$, $h:Z\to X$ and $v:Z\to Y$ with $v;g=h$. Let $M$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $r\in\mathbb N$, and $\alpha:M\to\mathcal O_X^r$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Write $T$ for the canonical section transport [def-sbc-pullback-section-factorization]. For every $x\in\Gamma(g^*M)$ and $i\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, the $i$-th coordinate of $h^*\alpha(Tx)$ under the canonical free pullback comparison is $v^\sharp$ of the $i$-th coordinate of $g^*\alpha(x)$. No affine, finite etale, or inverse hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Unfold the constructed pullbackSectionFactorization section map as the adjunction unit followed by the composition comparison.
Move α across the pullback composition comparison by naturality.
Move the pulled-back α across the adjunction unit by naturality.
Identify the composite free pullback comparison on pure tensors s⊗(t⊗e_i) with st e_i, then project to coordinate i. On the unit sheaf the section pullback is v.appTop.

theorem pullback_free_coordinates_naturality
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (h : Z ⟶ X) (v : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hv : v ≫ g = h) (M : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (α : M ⟶ free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))
    (x : Γ((pullback g).obj M, ⊤)) (i : Fin r) :
    freeSectionsEquiv (ULift.{u} (Fin r))
      (((pullback h).map α ≫ (pullbackFreeIso h (ULift.{u} (Fin r))).hom).app ⊤
        (pullbackSectionFactorization g h v hv M x)) (ULift.up i) =
      v.appTop (freeSectionsEquiv (ULift.{u} (Fin r))
        (((pullback g).map α ≫ (pullbackFreeIso g (ULift.{u} (Fin r))).hom).app ⊤ x)
          (ULift.up i))
